latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of 1688 Procurement Agent: a comprehensive coaching system for global buyers sourcing from 1688.com.

- Guides users through 6 key procurement stages: onboarding, product selection, supplier vetting, negotiation, quality control, and logistics.
- Offers practical tools: browser/app setup instructions, supplier credibility checklists, pricing breakdowns, and compliance guides.
- Structured frameworks for supplier evaluation, risk assessment, and negotiation tactics.
- Designed to empower users to handle most sourcing scenarios independently, with clear escalation paths for professional support.
- Serves Amazon FBA sellers, dropshippers, retail buyers, importers/exporters, and e-commerce operators.
